a.lede: Senators say officials hid a ruling on warrantless searches past its release deadline.
a.title: US officials want Section 702 renewed before damaging court ruling goes public

b.lede: Two US senators say the Trump administration is breaking the law by withholding the FISA court decision while it presses Congress to renew America’s most sweeping surveillance program.
b.title: The US Government Is Hiding a Secret Court Ruling About How It Spies on Americans
